details.description: Gemini 3.6 Flash is Google DeepMind's workhorse model in the Gemini 3 series, published July 21, 2026 and built on Gemini 3.5 Flash, delivering better coding, knowledge-work and multimodal performance with improved token efficiency over its predecessor. It accepts text, image, audio and video input over up to a 1M-token context window with 64K-token text output. As of September 2026 it remains Stable and actively served with no shutdown date announced, though Google's Gemini API documentation now describes it as its 'previous-generation' Flash model following the later releases of Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash.
advantages: Scores 83.0% on OSWorld-Verified, an agentic computer-use benchmark, per Google DeepMind's model card.
Scores 89.4% on CharXiv Reasoning, a chart-based information synthesis benchmark, with tools, per Google DeepMind's model card.
Scores 91.8% on the GDM-MRCR v2 8-needle long-context benchmark at 128k tokens, per Google DeepMind's model card.
Scores 78.0% on Terminal-bench 2.1, an agentic terminal-coding benchmark, per Google DeepMind's model card.
Scores 63.9% on MLE-Bench, a machine-learning-engineering benchmark, per Google DeepMind's model card.
disadvantages: Superseded within Google's own Flash line by Gemini 3.7 Flash (August 13, 2026) and Gemini 3.8 Flash (September 2, 2026); Google's documentation now labels it a 'previous-generation' Flash model.
Text-only output; does not generate audio or images, per Google's Gemini API model documentation.
Knowledge cutoff of March 2026, with some domains limited to January 2025, per Google DeepMind's model card.

notes: Catalog facts (1,048,576 input / 65,536 output tokens; gemini + vertex_ai-gemini-models providers) match Google's model card (1M input / 64K output) and its Gemini API / Google Cloud distribution channels. Catalog has no deprecation_date; Google's deprecations page lists release July 21, 2026 with 'No shutdown date announced,' consistent. The 'previous-generation' phrasing is quoted verbatim from Google's live models overview page (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models), confirmed against the raw page HTML; Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash release dates (Aug 13 and Sep 2, 2026) are from the same deprecations page. Elo-style benchmark (GDPVal-AA v2) excluded as not an accuracy score.
